<module id="alu">
    <description>An arithmetic logic unit (ALU) for performing various operations on two 32-bit inputs.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="a" width_description="[31:0]">First input operand.</input>
        <input id="b" width_description="[31:0]">Second input operand.</input>
        <input id="aluc" width_description="[5:0]">Control signal for selecting the operation to be performed.</input>
        <output id="r" width_description="[31:0]">Result of the operation.</output>
        <output id="zero">Zero flag indicating if the result is zero.</output>
        <output id="carry">Carry flag indicating if a carry occurred during the operation.</output>
        <output id="negative">Negative flag indicating if the result is negative.</output>
        <output id="overflow">Overflow flag indicating if an overflow occurred during the operation.</output>
        <output id="flag">Flag indicating the result of SLT and SLTU operations.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="ADD">6'b100000</parameter>
        <parameter id="ADDU">6'b100001</parameter>
        <parameter id="SUB">6'b100010</parameter>
        <parameter id="SUBU">6'b100011</parameter>
        <parameter id="AND">6'b100100</parameter>
        <parameter id="OR">6'b100101</parameter>
        <parameter id="XOR">6'b100110</parameter>
        <parameter id="NOR">6'b100111</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLT">6'b101010</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLTU">6'b101011</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLL">6'b000000</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRL">6'b000010</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRA">6'b000011</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLLV">6'b000100</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRLV">6'b000110</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRAV">6'b000111</parameter>
        <parameter id="LUI">6'b001111</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        <assign id="signed_a" width_description="[31:0]">Signed representation of input operand 'a'</assign>
        <assign id="signed_b" width_description="[31:0]">Signed representation of input operand 'b'</assign>
        <assign id="res" width_description="[31:0]">Register to hold the result of the operation</assign>
        <assign id="flag" width_description="[31:0]">Flag output</assign>
        
        <always_comb>
            <case id="operation_selection">
                <when condition="'aluc == ADD'>"
                    <assign id="res" width_description="[31:0]">Result of adding 'a' and 'b'</assign>
                </when>
                <when condition="'aluc == ADDU'>"
                    <assign id="res" width_description="[31:0]">Unsigned addition of 'a' and 'b'</assign>
                </when>
                <when condition="'aluc == SUB'>"
                    <assign id="res" width_description="[31:0]">Subtraction of 'a' and 'b'</assign>
                </when>
                <when condition="'aluc == SUBU'>"
                    <assign id="res" width_description="[31:0]">Unsigned subtraction of 'a' and 'b'</assign>
                </when>
                <when condition="'aluc == AND'>"
                    <assign id="res" width_description="[31:0]">Bitwise AND of 'a' and 'b'</assign>
                </when>
                <when condition="'aluc == OR'>"
                    <assign id="res" width_description="[31:0]">Bitwise OR of 'a' and 'b'</assign>
                </when>
                <when condition="'aluc == XOR'>"
                    <assign id="res" width_description="[31:0]">Bitwise XOR of 'a' and 'b'</assign>
                </when>
                <when condition="'aluc == NOR'>"
                    <assign id="res" width_description="[31:0]">Bitwise NOR of 'a' and 'b'</assign>
                </when>
                <when condition="'aluc == SLT'>"
                    <assign id="res" width_description="[31:0]">Set less than comparison of 'a' and 'b'</assign>
                </when>
                <when condition="'aluc == SLTU'>"
                    <assign id="res" width_description="[31:0]">Unsigned set less than comparison of 'a' and 'b'</assign>
                </when>
                <when condition="'aluc == SLL'>"
                    <assign id="res" width_description="[31:0]">Logical left shift of 'a' by 'b'</assign>
                </when>
                <when condition="'aluc == SRL'>"
                    <assign id="res" width_description="[31:0]">Logical right shift of 'a' by 'b'</assign>
                </when>
                <when condition="'aluc == SRA'>"
                    <assign id="res" width_description="[31:0]">Arithmetic right shift of 'a' by 'b'</assign>
                </when>
                <when condition="'aluc == SLLV'>"
                    <assign id="res" width_description="[31:0]">Variable logical left shift of 'a' by 'b[4:0]'</assign>
                </when>
                <when condition="'aluc == SRLV'>"
                    <assign id="res" width_description="[31:0]">Variable logical right shift of 'a' by 'b[4:0]'</assign>
                </when>
                <when condition="'aluc == SRAV'>"
                    <assign id="res" width_description="[31:0]">Variable arithmetic right shift of 'a' by 'b[4:0]'</assign>
                </when>
                <when condition="'aluc == LUI'>"
                    <assign id="res" width_description="[31:0]">Load upper immediate of 'a'</assign>
                </when>
                <default>
                    <assign id="res" width_description="[31:0]">Default case for undefined operations</assign>
                </default>
            </case>
            
            <if condition="'aluc == SLT || aluc == SLTU'>
                <assign id="flag" width_description="[31:0]">Flag set to '1' for SLT and SLTU operations</assign>
            </if>
            <else>
                <assign id="flag" width_description="[31:0]">Flag set to 'z' for other operations</assign>
            </else>
            
            <if condition="'res == 32'h00000000'>
                <assign id="zero" width_description="[31:0]">Zero flag set to '1' if result is zero</assign>
            </if>
            <else>
                <assign id="zero" width_description="[31:0]">Zero flag set to '0' if result is not zero</assign>
            </else>
            
            <if condition="'res[31] == 1'>
                <assign id="negative" width_description="[31:0]">Negative flag set to '1' if result is negative</assign>
            </if>
            <else>
                <assign id="negative" width_description="[31:0]">Negative flag set to '0' if result is positive</assign>
            </else>
            
            <if condition="'aluc == ADD || aluc == SUB'>
                <assign id="carry" width_description="[31:0]">Carry flag set based on addition/subtraction operations</assign>
            </if>
            <else>
                <assign id="carry" width_description="[31:0]">Carry flag set to 'z' for other operations</assign>
            </else>
            
            <if condition="'aluc == ADD || aluc == SUB'>
                <assign id="overflow" width_description="[31:0]">Overflow flag set based on addition/subtraction operations</assign>
            </if>
            <else>
                <assign id="overflow" width_description="[31:0]">Overflow flag set to 'z' for other operations</assign>
            </else>
        </always_comb>
    </logic_description>
    
    <implementation>Implements arithmetic and logic operations based on the control signal (aluc).</implementation>
</module>
